# ZenHotels

> > ZenHotels is a travel booking platform offering hand-picked hotel deals, destination guides, and curated travel experiences across global destinations including the United States, Greece, Turkey, France, Spain, Italy, and the United Kingdom.

The platform specializes in helping travelers discover and book accommodations ranging from luxury hotels and beach resorts to spa retreats and family-friendly vacation properties. ZenHotels provides comprehensive destination guides, travel planning resources, and access to tours and activities worldwide.

## Getting Started

- [ZenHotels – Find Your Adventure with Hand-Picked Travel Deals](https://deals.zenhotels.com/): Homepage for ZenHotels featuring curated travel deals across destinations
- [Discover Top Holiday Destinations with ZenHotels](https://deals.zenhotels.com/destinations/): Main destination directory for exploring travel options worldwide

## Destination Guides

- [USA Travel Guide | Plan Your Perfect USA Holidays](https://deals.zenhotels.com/destinations/united-states/): Comprehensive USA travel guide with visa info and regional destinations
- [Greece Travel Guide | Plan Your Trip to Greece with Expert Tips](https://deals.zenhotels.com/destinations/greece/): Greece destination guide covering islands, culture, and trip planning tips
